properties.name: Chungthang Town
properties.key_vulnerability: Confluence of Lachen Chu & Lachung Chu; direct downstream path of Teesta-III Dam
properties.status_notes: Severely impacted in Oct 2023 surge; key army transit hub and market.

properties.name: Teesta-III Hydroelectric Project (Chungthang Dam)
properties.key_vulnerability: Concrete-face rockfill dam directly in narrow gorge flow channel
properties.status_notes: Dam structure was overtopped and breached during Oct 4, 2023 flood wave.

properties.name: Indreni Suspension Bridge (Singtam)
properties.key_vulnerability: Low clearance above normal high-water level in gorge
properties.status_notes: Washed away in 2023 event; critical connectivity between East and South Sikkim.

properties.name: Singtam Municipal Town
properties.key_vulnerability: Dense riverfront residential and commercial development
properties.status_notes: Lower market inundated up to 2-3 meters during surge.

properties.name: Teesta-V Dam (Dikchu)
properties.key_vulnerability: Power station and spillway siltation under extreme bedload
properties.status_notes: Shut down due to massive silt load and structural scouring.

properties.name: Rangpo Border Town
properties.key_vulnerability: Mining ground, industrial plots and NH-10 roadbed
properties.status_notes: Flooding of low-lying industrial estate and highway closure.

properties.name: National Highway 10 (NH-10) Corridor
properties.key_vulnerability: Direct riverbank alignment along unstable debris slopes
properties.status_notes: Multiple breach sections cutting off Sikkim from Siliguri/Rest of India.

properties.name: Toong & Naga Villages
properties.key_vulnerability: Toong bridge approach roads and terrace agriculture
properties.status_notes: Bridge cut off; isolated North Sikkim communities.
